Official statistical-table volume has 581 identified table headings; 17 have selected adopted values, 11 have reviewed decisions without new adoption, and 553 await semantic review. Table II.10 fertility values conflict with the final report's prose and figure (AreaData evidence: burkina-faso-fertility-source-conflict-2026-09-25.md); do not adopt or reconcile them automatically. Inspect numeric columns, denominators and source versions; regional rates are not commune rates.

Volume 3 Annex 4 monetary-poverty values are small-area estimates combining EHCVM 2018 with 2019 census geography, not directly enumerated census poverty. Annexes 5-9 report distinct census measures. Two whole-city commune aggregates and four incomplete rows were withheld; recheck definitions, geography, and redistribution terms.
This is a modelled 2015 outcome using 2019 census covariates, not 2019 contraceptive prevalence. Three ambiguous commune name matches were withheld; review the crosswalk and raw reuse terms.

December 2024 communal development-plan (PCD) guide predates the 2025 territorial code and administrative reform. Check the guide's current applicability and the chosen locality's legal planning authority; no local plan is implied.

December 2024 regional development-plan (PRD) guide predates the 2025 territorial code and administrative reform. Do not equate a 2019 statistical region with a current planning body without legal crosswalk.
